description: Versioned test cases for matching ordered tool-produced lines to final added lines. Each expected entry is exact, normalized, or none.

cases.name: exact-with-blank-line
cases.description: All non-blank lines match exactly; a blank line anchors nothing.

cases.name: whitespace-normalized
cases.description: Internal whitespace differs, so it is a normalized (not exact) match.

cases.name: leading-trailing-trimmed-exact
cases.description: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed before comparison, so this is exact.

cases.name: ordered-gap
cases.description: An unmatched added line between two exact anchors stays none.

cases.name: skipped-claim-preserves-order
cases.description: A claim with no corresponding added line is skipped; order is preserved.

cases.name: duplicate-added-single-claim
cases.description: One claim matches the earliest occurrence; the duplicate stays none.

cases.name: duplicate-claim-single-added
cases.description: Extra claims beyond the added lines are simply unused.

cases.name: blank-only
cases.description: Blank claims and blank added lines never match.

cases.name: normalized-fills-gap-between-exact-anchors
cases.description: A normalized match fills the gap between two exact anchors.

cases.name: order-preserved-no-cross
cases.description: Crossing matches are not allowed; the earliest order-preserving match wins.

cases.name: normalized-not-across-exact-anchor
cases.description: A normalized match cannot cross an exact anchor.

cases.name: no-claims
cases.description: With no claims, every added line is unmatched.

cases.name: no-added
cases.description: With no added lines there is nothing to match.
